description: Agent-facing tiered workflow for dxTrade5 web UI: concept → IA → live locations. Browser truth beats wiki/design for layout.
content_policy: Functional/process only. No credentials or secrets in JSON. Do not paste full Confluence HTML or large Figma exports into the repo.

staleness_doctrine: Confluence pages under Cornertrader Requirements (CT) and dxBro Requirements (DR) explain intent and acceptance-style behaviour—they may not match every QA build.
Figma frames describe target UX; deployed spacing, labels, and feature flags can differ.
For *where* a control is on screen, prefer Stage 3 locations + live snapshots (Chrome DevTools MCP) on the target host.
truth_hierarchy: 1_live_ui: Snapshot / exploration on target deployment (e.g. ctqa)

tier_sequence.label: Stage 1 — concept-map.json
tier_sequence.goal: Resolve feature IDs, dependencies, and synonyms before searching the DOM.

tier_sequence.label: Stage 2 — ia-map.json
tier_sequence.goal: Narrow navigation using primary_path / areas (no selectors).

tier_sequence.label: Stage 3 — locations/<env>.json + browser
tier_sequence.goal: Verify or record concrete steps and labels on the target host; cite verified_at.

design_anchors.mcp_note: Figma get_figma_data requires fileKey from a file or design URL; attach node-id when sharing a frame link.
